description: Code-reuse Option A: create the new internal library crate crates/wal-cli-common and move walx's shared CLI logic into it (mask glob, zip-slip/reserved/sanitize safety, version-selector + UTC --at grammar, CliError, and the extract/cat execution engines), then refactor walx to consume it. Add a CLI-layer `names` module (matching + log_bytes) that the library does not expose. Register both wal-cli-common and the (empty) walrus-cli crate in the root Cargo.toml members list -- the one allowed edit outside the new crates. This is a BEHAVIOUR-PRESERVING move: walx's existing tests must stay green unchanged. Independent of FEAT-002/003 only in that it comes FIRST (they depend on it).
steps: Create crates/wal-cli-common/Cargo.toml: package name `wal-cli-common`, publish = false, version/edition/rust-version/license.workspace = true; [dependencies] walrus-fmt = { workspace = true } (DEFAULT features -- no diff needed here), anyhow = { workspace = true }; [dev-dependencies] tempfile = "3".

Create crates/wal-cli-common/src/lib.rs with module declarations and re-exports (pub mod error/mask/safety/selector/extract/cat/names) and a crate-level doc comment; #![warn(missing_docs)] optional but keep /// on public items.
Move crates/walx/src/mask.rs -> crates/wal-cli-common/src/mask.rs verbatim (its #[cfg(test)] tests move with it). Make `matches` pub.
Move crates/walx/src/safety.rs -> crates/wal-cli-common/src/safety.rs verbatim (NameRefusal, classify, is_zip_slip, sanitize, localized_join, tests). Keep all pub.

Split crates/walx/src/args.rs: move Selector, effective_selector, set_selector, parse_version_value, parse_index_value, parse_at_utc (+ civil_to_epoch helper) and their tests into crates/wal-cli-common/src/selector.rs; move CliError into crates/wal-cli-common/src/error.rs. Both pub.

Move crates/walx/src/extract.rs -> crates/wal-cli-common/src/extract.rs and crates/walx/src/cat.rs -> crates/wal-cli-common/src/cat.rs; update their `use crate::` paths to the new module locations (crate::mask, crate::safety, crate::selector::Selector, crate::extract::reconstruct_with_fallback). Keep ExtractArgs/CatArgs/run/reconstruct_with_fallback/output_dir pub.

Create crates/wal-cli-common/src/names.rs: `pub fn matching(archive: &walrus_fmt::Archive, mask: &str) -> Vec<String>` returning the stored names a glob selects via mask::matches over archive.files(); `pub fn log_bytes(archive: &walrus_fmt::Archive, name: &str) -> u64` summing the serialised byte size of the file's change records (reuse archive.records(name)). Unit-test both over a built fixture.

Refactor crates/walx/src/main.rs to `use wal_cli_common::{...}` for the moved items; delete the now-moved modules from walx (mask.rs, safety.rs, extract.rs, cat.rs) and the moved parts of args.rs (leave only any walx-local arg glue if needed, else delete args.rs and inline). Keep walx's dispatch, banner, and option scan.

Edit the root Cargo.toml [workspace] members: add "crates/wal-cli-common" and "crates/walrus-cli". Create a minimal crates/walrus-cli/Cargo.toml ([[bin]] name="walrus", path src/main.rs; deps walrus-fmt features=["diff"], wal-cli-common path dep, anyhow; dev-dep tempfile) and a stub crates/walrus-cli/src/main.rs (`fn main() {}` or a trivial ExitCode) so the workspace compiles.
Keep every walx tests/*.rs file UNCHANGED; they must pass against the refactored walx.
acceptance_criteria: `cargo test -p walx` passes with ALL pre-existing walx tests green and unchanged.
`cargo test -p wal-cli-common` passes (the moved unit tests for mask/safety/selector plus the new names tests).
`cargo build -p walrus-cli` compiles the stub binary.
No file in crates/wal-cli-common or crates/walx exceeds 400 non-test lines; strict ASCII; `cargo fmt -- --check` and `cargo clippy -p wal-cli-common -p walx -- -D warnings` clean.
crates/walker and crates/walrus are byte-for-byte unchanged; the only workspace-level edit is the two added members.
verification: git -C c:/workspace/Walrus/.worktrees/frw11-cli status --porcelain -- crates/walker crates/walrus  (expect NO changes under those paths)
findings: Crate `wal-cli-common` (publish=false) at crates/wal-cli-common consumed via `use wal_cli_common::...`. FINAL MODULE PATHS and PUBLIC NAMES for FEAT-002: (1) wal_cli_common::error -> `pub struct CliError { pub message: String, pub code: u8 }` with `CliError::usage(impl Into<String>) -> Self` (RC 2), plus Display + std::error::Error impls. (2) wal_cli_common::mask -> `pub fn matches(mask: &str, name: &str) -> bool` (segment-aware /-glob; everything else private). (3) wal_cli_common::safety -> `pub enum NameRefusal { ZipSlip, Unrepresentable(String) }`; `pub fn classify(name: &str) -> Result<(), NameRefusal>`; `pub fn is_zip_slip(name: &str) -> bool`; `pub fn sanitize(name: &str) -> String`; `pub fn localized_join(base: &Path, name: &str) -> PathBuf`. (4) wal_cli_common::selector -> `pub enum Selector { Current, Original, Index(usize), Relative(i64), At(i64) }` with `Selector::to_version() -> walrus_fmt::Version` and `Selector::is_numeric_index() -> bool`; `pub fn effective_selector(Option<Selector>) -> Selector`; `pub fn set_selector(&mut Option<Selector>, Selector) -> Result<(), CliError>`; `pub fn parse_version_value(&str) -> Result<Selector, CliError>`; `pub fn parse_index_value(&str) -> Result<Selector, CliError>`; `pub fn parse_at_utc(&str) -> Result<i64, CliError>` (fixed-shape UTC YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ -> epoch secs). (5) wal_cli_common::extract -> `pub struct ExtractArgs { archive: PathBuf, mask: Option<String>, selector: Selector, output: PathBuf, force: bool, sanitize: bool }`; `pub fn run(&ExtractArgs) -> anyhow::Result<u8>`; `pub fn reconstruct_with_fallback(&Archive, &FileId, name: &str, &Selector) -> Result<(Vec<u8>, u8)>`; `pub fn output_dir(Option<&str>) -> PathBuf`. (6) wal_cli_common::cat -> `pub struct CatArgs { archive: PathBuf, file: String, selector: Selector }`; `pub fn run(&CatArgs) -> anyhow::Result<u8>`. (7) wal_cli_common::names (CLI-layer, NOT in walrus-fmt) -> `pub fn matching(&walrus_fmt::Archive, mask: &str) -> Vec<String>` (glob -> exact stored names, files() order; empty vec on no match); `pub fn log_bytes(&walrus_fmt::Archive, name: &str) -> u64` (sum of per-record serde_json JSONL line size incl. trailing newline; 0 if name selects no file / no records). DEPENDENCY NOTE: wal-cli-common depends on walrus-fmt (DEFAULT features), anyhow, AND serde_json (added beyond the literal step-1 list -- required so log_bytes serialises records to the on-disk log.jsonl form; serde_json was already in walrus-fmt's tree so it does not widen the INV-2 auditable surface). walrus-cli (bin name `walrus`, crates/walrus-cli/src/main.rs stub) depends on walrus-fmt features=["diff"], wal-cli-common path dep, anyhow, dev-dep tempfile. walx now has a path dep on wal-cli-common and its src/ holds ONLY main.rs (args.rs/mask.rs/safety.rs/extract.rs/cat.rs deleted; main.rs keeps dispatch + Scan option-scan + print_usage, importing the shared items). Verified: walx 24 integ tests green unchanged; wal-cli-common 19 tests; walrus-fmt 159 tests (no regression); fmt/clippy clean; cargo tree -p walrus-cli shows none of pulldown-cmark/scraper/csv/printpdf/docx-rs/egui/eframe/encoding_rs (similar+unicode-segmentation present via walrus-fmt diff feature, expected).
